title: Law to help small businesses hurt by road construction
summary: This bill would require the Department of Small Business Services to run a program giving loans, grants, services or materials to small businesses harmed by city construction projects that disrupt traffic for at least 30 days. Loans would be capped at $50,000 per storefront per year with interest no higher than 3%, and grants or reimbursements would be capped at $15,000 per storefront per year. The agency would have to set an application process and decide eligibility within 30 days, disbursing funds within 14 days after approval.
